title: Beef and Rice with Cheese Sauce

content.title: About
content.content: Beef and rice with cheese sauce is a ready‑to‑eat dish featuring tender beef pieces, fluffy rice, and a creamy cheese sauce. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The beef‑rice combination is a staple in many world cuisines.
Cheese sauce is typically made from cream cheese, milk, and seasonings.
The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheated in a microwave.
Adding vegetables such as broccoli increases its nutritional value.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Beef provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Energy‑providing carbohydrates
items.content: Rice supplies carbohydrates that are quickly converted into energy.

items.title: Calcium from cheese sauce
items.content: The cheese sauce adds calcium, important for bone and tooth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both beef and rice contain B6 and B12 vitamins that support the nervous system.

items.title: Iron
items.content: Beef is a good source of heme iron, which aids hemoglobin formation.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cheese sauce may trigger reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Prepared sauces often contain added salt; individuals with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: Creamy cheese sauce can be high in saturated fats, so moderation is advised.

items.title: Proper cooking
items.content: Beef should be fully cooked to avoid food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the dish in a microwave or skillet until it reaches 75 °C. Serve hot, optionally garnish with fresh herbs or vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C in an airtight container for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C and thaw in the refrigerator before reheating.
